items.text: Free courses for law students in India are useful when they build a skill you can show, such as legal research, drafting, negotiation, data privacy awareness or document tools, and you should choose courses that produce a sample piece of work and avoid anything that promises jobs.
Pick one practice area, take a free course in its core skill and produce a short memo or draft you can show.
Check who runs the course and avoid paid add-ons that promise placements.
